clarifications: Task scope is strictly 5 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic authorization is FALSE (zero semantic files modified).
G-042 guardrails authorization is FALSE (zero guardrails modified).
Character Posture concepts are exactly COVERED, EXPOSED, TRANSITIONING_TO_COVERED, and TRANSITIONING_TO_EXPOSED.
Squad Posture Intent concepts are exactly WANT_COVERED and WANT_EXPOSED; squad intent is squad-global semantic state.
Squad membership, 5-member arrays, formation slots, and Controlled Character are NOT modeled in T-012 data structures.
Explicit initialization: creation/wrapper APIs require explicit supplied values; no default COVERED, EXPOSED, WANT_COVERED, or WANT_EXPOSED are invented.

Intent-driven transition: transition direction is derived strictly from current Character Posture and current Squad Posture Intent; public T-012 API provides zero arbitrary caller-selected transition target authority.

Authority boundary: beginIntentDrivenPostureTransition is a posture-axis / squad-intent transform only; it does not evaluate STUN, future control restrictions, weapon restrictions, or global combat actionability.
STUN boundary: whether STUN prevents starting a new posture transition remains unresolved and is not decided by T-012.

Active transition atomicity: changing Squad Posture Intent while in TRANSITIONING_TO_COVERED or TRANSITIONING_TO_EXPOSED does not cancel, reverse, pause, replace, or duplicate the active transition; the active transition remains unchanged and the latest intent is retained independently.

Transition completion: explicit completion (completeCharacterPostureTransition); TRANSITIONING_TO_COVERED -> COVERED, TRANSITIONING_TO_EXPOSED -> EXPOSED; calling completion on stable posture is rejected.

Post-completion reevaluation: reaching stable posture reevaluates latest Squad Posture Intent and reports next applicable intent-driven transition; does NOT automatically begin the follow-up transition inside the completion call.
T-011 kernel integration: posture transitions remain pure synchronous domain functions; no EventBatch, executeEventBatch, or EffectIntent forcing; no synthetic domain events emitted.

Metadata preservation: getDomainState() preserves gameplayImplemented: false because false is the existing Human-Trusted value, the lifecycle meaning for changing it to true is not formally defined, and T-012 has no authority to redefine that metadata meaning.
